name: alfacode-team/hkm-plugin-push
description: Device-token registration and push delivery over APNs and FCM HTTP v1, with a delivery outbox and automatic pruning of dead tokens.

suggest.ext-curl: Needed by the HttpClient plugin, and it must be built with nghttp2: Apple requires HTTP/2 and refuses HTTP/1.1.

//require-dev: firebase/php-jwt is a TEST dependency only, used as an independent oracle: tokens are signed by this plugin's own Domain/Jwt and verified by a library we did not write. Signing in production needs nothing but ext-openssl, so no project has to install it.
